What happens when kids train their memory? A class found out.

Kevin explains that if a child can improve how they recall, it changes everything. He tells of a seventh grade class he taught memory skills to in nine hours.

By the end of the school year, he says, they were eight months ahead of the curriculum and their vocabulary was at college sophomore level. Absences were virtually zero because the kids couldn't wait to go to school.

In his view, excelling lifts self-image and self-esteem.

What made you feel confident at school?
